mapLocationServiceOff: Turn on location to see capsules near you

@mapLocationServiceOff.description: Toast on the map when the phone's location service is switched off.

mapLocationDenied: Allow location access to see capsules near you

@mapLocationDenied.description: Toast on the map when location permission was denied.

mapLocationUnknown: We could not detect your location

@mapLocationUnknown.description: Toast on the map when no position could be found although location is allowed.

@mapCapsuleReady.description: Line in the small window above a capsule pin when the capsule is already open.

@mapCapsuleOpensIn.description: Countdown in the small window above a locked capsule's pin. {time} is a compact duration made of the mapDuration* parts, e.g. '2d 5h 30m 15s'.

@mapDurationDays.description: Days part of the compact countdown. Keep it as short as possible.

@mapDurationHours.description: Hours part of the compact countdown. Keep it as short as possible.

@mapDurationMinutes.description: Minutes part of the compact countdown. Keep it as short as possible.

@mapDurationSeconds.description: Seconds part of the compact countdown. Keep it as short as possible.

@mapCapsuleOpen.description: Button in the window above an open capsule's pin: shows the capsule. A verb.

@mapCapsuleLocked.description: Disabled button in the window above a capsule that has not opened yet. Agrees with 'capsule'.

@mapCapsuleNoDescription.description: Shown in the capsule card opened from the map when the capsule has no description.

mapFirstCapsuleBody: Take a photo here and choose when it opens.

@mapZoomIn.description: Screen reader label of the map's + button.

@mapZoomOut.description: Screen reader label of the map's − button.

@mapCompass.description: Screen reader label of the map compass, shown while the map is turned; a tap points it north.

@mapFilter.description: Map button (screen reader): open the map filter.

mapFilterActive: {count, plural, =1{Filter the map, 1 choice on} other{Filter the map, {count} choices on}}

@mapFilterActive.description: Map filter button while some choices narrow the map.

@mapFilterTitle.description: Title of the map filter sheet.

@mapFilterMine.description: Map filter: the user's own capsules (and co-authored).

@mapFilterOthers.description: Map filter: public capsules of people who are not friends.

@mapFilterState.description: Map filter section: open capsules or ones that open later.

@mapFilterLocked.description: Map filter: capsules that open later.

@mapFilterColors.description: Map filter section: pin colours (none chosen = all).

@mapFilterReset.description: Map filter: back to showing everything.

@mapCreditsButton.description: Screen reader label of the map's (i) button.

@mapCreditsTitle.description: Title of the sheet with the map's data sources and their licences.

mapCreditsDescription: The map is made from these sources. Tap one to open it.

@mapCreditsDescription.description: Under the title of the map data sheet.

@mapCreditsImprove.description: Opens OpenStreetMap's page for reporting a mistake in the map.

@mapCreditsRenderer.description: The open source library that draws the map; opens its website.

mapCapsuleUnavailable: This capsule is no longer available

@mapCapsuleUnavailable.description: A pin tapped while the map was still loading: the capsule was deleted, hidden or is no longer visible to the user.
